Rscript - <<'RS'
load('/data/ratingData5')
library(tidyr)
# aggregate ratings per participant, time, and US valence
ratingData5Aggr <- aggregate(likingRating ~ ParticipantNumber + correspondingTime + correspondingUS, ratingData5, FUN = mean)
ratingData5Aggr$USval <- ifelse(substr(as.character(ratingData5Aggr$correspondingUS),1,1)=='p','positive','negative')
ratingData5AggrW <- spread(ratingData5Aggr, key = 'USval', value = 'likingRating')
ratingData5AggrW$EC <- ratingData5AggrW$positive - ratingData5AggrW$negative
print(aggregate(EC ~ correspondingTime, ratingData5AggrW, mean))
RS
